judgment_context: These are dedicated webshell and socket-shell payload components, not documentation or general-purpose runtimes. Kali and pentest-tool packaging explains provenance and possible authorized use but supplies no deployment authorization. Explicit remote command channels tip the individual judgments toward MALICIOUS. Findings describe static capabilities; successful installation, reachability, exploitation and operator intent on a live host are unknown.

members.marker_line: Laudanum PHP shell: command payload; malformed template; move traits
evidence: POST command is assigned to $command and passed to proc_open; stdout/stderr are read into the session output. Client IP filtering, SHA1 password comparison, nonce and session checks precede it.

The supplied $users assignment lacks a terminating semicolon. The exact file cannot parse; this is a malformed shell payload template, not evidence of successful execution. Old brace-offset syntax also limits runtime compatibility.

members.marker_line: Laudanum ASP shell: IP-gated requests launch arbitrary commands
evidence: REMOTE_ADDR must equal the configured IP or the page returns 404 and exits. Request.Form(cmd) becomes cmd, then WScript.Shell.Exec(cmd); StdOut.ReadAll is rendered into the response.
The ASP Exec API launches a requested program; shell metacharacters require an explicitly requested cmd.exe /c. The explanatory HTML does not itself launch cmd.exe.

members.marker_line: WordPress reverse shell: POST selects shell peer; move PHP traits
evidence: POST ip and port override defaults 10.2.2.1:8888. fsockopen returns the socket used by the stream relay.

proc_open launches uname -a; w; id; /bin/sh -i with three pipes. The loop moves socket reads to pipe 0 and pipe 1/2 reads back to that same socket. Optional fork/setsid detaches; umask(0) changes the file creation mask.

members.marker_line: PHP reverse shell: socket relays interactive sh; move PHP traits
evidence: The same pipe/socket relay launches an interactive shell and sends its output to 10.2.2.1:8888. Both endpoint values are constants in this file.
Optional pcntl_fork/posix_setsid detach the process. No credential theft, privilege escalation, encryption or disk destruction is established.

members.marker_line: Laudanum WP shell: request commands; login disabled; move PHP traits
evidence: POST command reaches proc_open after directory and history handling, and child stdout/stderr are appended to response output. The active command branch is if(true); the local login form is disabled by if(false).
It includes ipcheck.php. The supplied helper admits three configured addresses and returns 404 otherwise; disabled local authentication is not proof the page is globally reachable.

members.marker_line: JSP command WAR: request executes commands; fix XML attribution
evidence: The WAR contains a deployable cmd.jsp and a web.xml descriptor, not a compiled servlet class. In cmd.jsp, request.getParameter(cmd) flows directly into Runtime.getRuntime().exec and child output is printed to the HTTP response.
The JSP has no authentication or IP gate. The XML only declares its JSP servlet resource; Command and /cmd.jsp strings do not establish Laudanum identity.

members.marker_line: Hidden PHP shell: request-chosen callable; correct callback placement
evidence: Adjacent executable statements @extract($_REQUEST) and @die($ctime($atime)) allow request fields to select both a callable and its argument. Error suppression hides failures; there is no IP or credential check.
A system callable can launch OS commands; phpinfo or other PHP functions can also be selected. The exact bytes do not require eval or a fixed OS command sink. No encoded payload needs decoding.

members.marker_line: GoAhead bind aarch64: load-time socket shell; move name trait
evidence: Gzip expands to a Linux ELF shared library. Dynamic initialization points at the payload routine; its reachable calls remove LD_PRELOAD and fork. The parent exits; the child runs the socket shell.
The accepted client socket is duplicated onto descriptors 0, 1 and 2 before a loop tries shell paths with execl. The listener binds INADDR_ANY on template port 55555 without authentication.
Bundled C source corroborates the recovered code but does not substitute for this member's constructor, relocation and call-site inspection. Gzip is packaging; no concealed encrypted stage was found.
